name: Igarashi
source: Igarashi is a student from an unknown institution who was among the many casualties in the train crash where Otonashi was also involved in. After surviving the collision, Igarashi rescued as many of the injured passengers as he can. He later meets Otonashi, and they became one of the very few people who tries to organize the resources they need for survival after the accident blocked all possible exits.
